content.name: panas-token-ecosystem
content.description: Ecosistema multichain Panas Token - Panacea | Icono SA

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:bot"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run submodules:update && npm run install:submodules
scripts.build: echo 'Building panas-token-ecosystem...' && mkdir -p dist && cp -r scripts dist/ && cp -r config dist/ && cp -r docker dist/ && cp package.json dist/ && cp README.md dist/
scripts.release:create: git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.docker:build:release: docker build -t panas-token-ecosystem:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") . && docker build -t panas-token-ecosystem:latest .
scripts.docker:tag:release: docker tag panas-token-ecosystem:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") ghcr.io/panacea-icono/panas-token-ecosystem:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && docker tag panas-token-ecosystem:latest ghcr.io/panacea-icono/panas-token-ecosystem:latest
